reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this hits a real problem for me. The named lab and the batch report on the page make me trust it more than a random listing, and at $24.99 with the empty-box guarantee, one box is an easy risk.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And it's made in China, so I only believe it if the lab report really matches my batch.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic and not tied to a batch number, or if the price went above about $35 for one box, I would pass.
